planning_notes: The request for 5 targets is fulfilled by selecting 5 distinct concepts from the available 10. To ensure non-redundancy and medium difficulty, each target targets a different pedagogical facet: 1) Conceptual understanding of the Reparameterization Trick, 2) Theoretical rationale for KL Divergence, 3) Code interpretation of the Encoder architecture, 4) Error diagnosis in the Loss Function, and 5) Practical application to Fashion-MNIST. This covers the core theoretical and practical components of the VAE lecture without overlapping assessment angles.
